scope: Boolean whole-record routing and a separate 1024-Fetch class; conditional CSLib segment proofs and recursion, plus a separate complete small countdown fixture. Full original CSLib execution is not proved.

initial_final_class.note: Final quotas and approved relations; before partial-padding witness fix and test-harness corrections.

fixed.note: Final production witness fix and all regression tests.

benchmark_method: Generate the native sample, compile once, and share the immutable setup among scoped workers with independent Rayon pools. Every sample runs the production witness builder, prover and verifier. Worker wall includes pool creation, all proof checks and create-new file writes when requested; loading, native replay and setup are timed separately. Samples include startup effects and do not establish steady-state or full-workload rates.
benchmark_note: Rows include actual per-family microstep counts. A 1024-Fetch quota is not a guarantee of 1024 logical steps. Family and memory limits can end a batch sooner; Apply and Return also consume logical fuel.

new_class_leaf_tests.configuration: The test selects a fixed class before stdin reads; fresh child receives only the expected 57 words and raw proof with its environment cleared.
new_class_leaf_tests.note: These three tests ran before the final padding-only witness fix; approved matrices, statements and proof keys are identical. The final code also passes a later genuine server leaf receiver, dirty-buffer regression and complete countdown proof.

unrelated_broad_test_attempt.claim: No complete-suite pass is claimed; all 77 affected ordinary tests passed separately after the padding fix.

recursive_cslib_execution_chain.source: first three final-class proofs produced on the CPU server
recursive_cslib_execution_chain.fresh_receiver_mutations: Final receiver rejects 114 mutations: low bit 0 and high bit 63 independently for each of 57 public words.
recursive_cslib_execution_chain.scope: Conditional execution chain; original source admission and complete CSLib execution are outside the claim.

fixed_padding_regression.trigger: A small Program commitment bridge follows the large execution proof in the same process and reuses its witness buffers.
fixed_padding_regression.cause: The pinned x86 RS kernel rounds reads to 512 bits within 8192-bit windows; unused rows in a partially live group must be zero even in support-aware mode.
fixed_padding_regression.fix: Both custom Boolean writers zero the final eight-row group and fully clear row domains below 64 rows. Unused complete groups remain untouched only when the upstream prover permits it.
fixed_padding_regression.regression: Three genuine Program commitment proofs for source lengths 47 and 977 with select-gate z/a/b buffers deliberately filled with nonzero data before witness generation.

failed_address_limit_trial.name: boolean-1024-eight
failed_address_limit_trial.cause: 950102800-byte allocation failed under the virtual-address cap; resident memory was below the physical cap.
failed_address_limit_trial.retry: 1536 GiB address allowance with unchanged 400 GiB physical cap, in a new output directory; all sixteen proofs verified.
failed_address_limit_trial.gnu_time_footer_caveat: The footer says status zero after reporting signal 6; the actual command returned 134.

full_workload_estimates.limitations: These are projections from a Fetch-based count floor and short conditional proof windows, excluding native replay, admission, output and recursion. Byte/hash-heavy phases can fill other quotas earlier. No complete CSLib run was launched.
